# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price often reverts to the intraday VWAP after an initial opening‑range break, offering a mean‑reversion edge. The strategy captures this by entering long when price breaks above the ORH in the first 30 minutes but then closes below VWAP on the same 5‑minute bar, with a volume filter to ensure institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Entry: Within the first 30 minutes (09:30-10:00 EST), if price breaks above the opening‑range high (ORH) and the same 5‑minute bar closes below the VWAP, enter long at the bar’s close. Require volume > 1.5× the average 5‑minute volume of the first 30 minutes.  
Exit: Chart‑stop at ORH (invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R (risk‑reward), runner trail 15% off highest close since entry.  
Regime filters: Only trade when VIX < 20 and time is between 09:45‑10:30 EST to avoid choppy, high‑volatility opens.
